card.fires_on: The word Patients at the start of the sentence right after the statement that depression and other psychiatric disorders are associated with increased suicide risk. It appears in the antidepressant boxed warning.

modes.label: Warning sentence start
modes.description: The word Patients begins the sentence that says patients of all ages started on antidepressants should be monitored.
